findings.claim: wp_cuda_launch_kernel calls ordinary cuLaunchKernel_f; no cooperative-grid launch found in inspected Warp launch path.
cluster_dim is a host launch grouping option; no grid-barrier primitive found in inspected context/builtins.
adj_min and adj_max choose second operand at equal finite operands; adj_clamp chains those derivatives and excludes x gradient at upper equality.
Adam has one shared host step counter, unlike independently stepped native checkpoint entries; expression order differs.
rand_pcg/rand_init seed/hash path; not native Torch CUDA Philox equivalence.
Trainable tile MLP example uses hidden dimension32 and float16; native FP32 width512 not established.
Example performs FFT convolution/filtering, not native Conv2D CNN backward proof.

limits: Source inspection is scoped to installed files, not a proof against future/custom Warp extensions.
No tile precision/occupancy/performance experiment was run.
No custom native injection or runtime patch is used by component.
